yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm do the cha-cha? 💃 Cocktail Sort, also known as bidirectional bubble sort, is here to spice up your sorting game! We're diving deep into how this unique algorithm works, visualizing its dual-directional passes, and showing you why it's more than just a fancy bubble sort. Get ready for some serious code-flow magic! 🚀

In this video, we'll cover:
✅ What is Cocktail Sort?
✅ How does it work (with cool animations!)?
✅ Cocktail Sort vs. Bubble Sort: What's the difference?
✅ Complexity and when to use it.
✅ Real-world Python implementation.
